interpretation.qmix_no_gru: Remove recurrent memory, preserve hidden width; parameter count differs and is reported.
interpretation.qmix_vdn: Replace nonlinear state-conditioned mixer with additive VDN.
interpretation.qmix_static_mixer: Retain monotone nonlinear mixer; remove state-conditioned hypernetworks.
interpretation.qmix_no_mixer_shared: Remove joint mixer; independent TD losses with shared local network.
interpretation.qmix_unshared: Keep QMIX mixer, remove local-network parameter sharing.
interpretation.iql_independent: Remove mixer and sharing together; multi-factor reference, not isolated one-component attribution.
interpretation.qmix_no_balance_reward: Set only balance gain to zero; keep the same terminal balanced target and physical metrics.

held_fixed: Predictive screen, plant interlock, data model, training steps, initial-state distribution, hold requirement and test scenarios.
no_shield_ablation: Handled in E2 raw/same-weights-filtered/retrained comparisons; not duplicated here.
capacity_caveat: This is a functional ablation suite, not parameter-count-matched expressivity proof.
test_protocol: The same predeclared E3 tests are reused for paired comparison; do not adapt variants after viewing outcomes.
